root_cause: The protected-main authority accepted a successful Supabase GitHub App production check for social-recovery-runner, but the provider remained on the previous source. Supabase deploy-to-production only deploys Edge Functions declared in supabase/config.toml; social-recovery-runner and powerhouse-social-publisher were not declared, so the check could be green while those functions were outside deployment scope.
prevention_rule: Every Edge Function selected by the protected-main production authority must exist and be explicitly declared in supabase/config.toml. A config.toml or functions/_shared change resolves to the declared function set, never every directory. Missing declarations fail closed before provider attestation.

docs: Supabase GitHub integration deploy-to-production deploys Edge Functions declared in config.toml
runtime: social-recovery-runner provider v7 differed from protected main after a successful exact-SHA Supabase production check
